mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.8% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts Federal Reserve rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 5.8% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS growth is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction term in regression is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS above 0.5% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with PAYEMS growth for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has been below 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of INDPRO and GDPC1 decline is not significant (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window, or interaction term in regression is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom (HOUST above 1000 for 3 consecutive months), strong residential construction activity boosts consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST has exceeded 1000 for 3 consecutive months.
